freelook.config.title: FreeLook Settings
freelook.config.zoom_out_duration.toolti: Time in seconds to smoothly glide out into 3rd person when pressing FreeLook.
freelook.config.zoom_in_duration.tooltip: Time in seconds to return to 1st person upon releasing FreeLook. Set to 0.00s for instant snap-back.
freelook.config.zoom_out_step.tooltip: Distance change in blocks per scroll tick when zooming out (pushing camera back).
freelook.config.zoom_in_step.tooltip: Distance change in blocks per scroll tick when zooming in (pulling camera forward).
freelook.config.zoom_smoothing.tooltip: Interpolation speed when zooming in/out with the scroll wheel.
freelook.config.min_distance.tooltip: Minimum camera distance allowed when zooming in.
freelook.config.max_distance.tooltip: Maximum camera distance allowed when zooming out.
freelook.config.invert_scroll.tooltip: Invert mouse wheel scroll zoom direction.
freelook.config.smooth_camera.tooltip: Apply cinematic inertia to camera panning. Turn off for crisp 1:1 mouse movement.
freelook.config.reset_all.tooltip: Reset all options to their original default values.
